entries.03c2c1289d9f7a05: This is a consulting service to raise the search ranking of clients' Web sites on search results screens.
entries.1015eff7e0018354: It is a business model in which the company purchases ad space from media operators and sells it to clients through performance-based advertising, and earns media fees and consulting fees through SEO consulting that supports improvement of search rankings.
entries.10ac3c9c5752dab5: Companies that want to strengthen traffic to their Web sites
entries.1f72b86b3c29316f: A business supporting companies' digital marketing through two services: internet advertising operation and SEO consulting.
entries.21f961b726efd002: A consulting service to raise the search ranking of a client's Web site on search results pages. It selects target keywords, formulates strategy based on analysis of the current situation and of competitors, optimizes the structure of the Web site, and also plans and produces article pages within the Web site. Using in-house developed tools, it efficiently carries out everything from data collection and analysis to planning measures and calculating simulations.
entries.2995398e982c4d85: SEO consulting fees and article content production fees
entries.312307945910df83: Media fees and consulting fees from the sale of ad space
entries.319dc0614eda413e: Customers are companies that place advertisements and advertising agencies
entries.31a90ddeccee0c25: Performance-based advertising (search-linked advertising, display advertising, in-feed advertising, etc.)
entries.369a6f0f2f05d54a: For performance-based advertising such as search-linked and display advertising, it provides services from planning and design of operational measures through monitoring and improvement of delivery results. In addition, it provides SEO consulting to raise search rankings and planning and production of article content, and uses in-house developed tools for both services.
entries.4601c8daa5534725: Provision of performance-based advertising and SEO consulting
entries.4b3d996965d6ea37: A business supporting companies' digital marketing through two services: internet advertising operation and SEO consulting. The business is carried out by the company and its four consolidated subsidiaries, five in total, and it has two channels: direct provision to clients and provision through advertising agencies.
entries.55e233bdbfc0379d: Because the effectiveness of performance-based advertising varies greatly depending on the operator, the company conducts 3C analysis, creates personas and plans media, then designs operational measures with an understanding of the algorithmic characteristics of each medium, and operates by monitoring and improving delivery results in real time. In SEO consulting, using in-house developed tools, it states that it can carry out data collection, analysis, measure planning and simulation calculations more efficiently than before. It uses a method that quantitatively surveys elements correlated with search rankings through differences from competitor sites, and designs keyword strategy and calculates potential based on evidence.
entries.5dff7378c14c57ad: A service providing operation-based advertising such as search ads, display ads and in-feed ads.
entries.61333a0093532ef8: A service providing operation-based advertising such as search ads, display ads and in-feed ads. It purchases ad space from media operators and, after providing consulting, sells the ad space to clients. Because advertising results vary greatly depending on the operator, it designs operational measures such as keyword selection and budget allocation, and makes improvements through real-time monitoring. It also accepts orders for creative production.
entries.7453db1cbaf40335: A company specializing in digital marketing, led by Sōgo Ichihara
entries.910323057a55c642: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥539 million.
entries.a063a245454c9cd4: “Cre Tech Force,” an AI-based solution for analysis and production of advertising creatives
entries.a46fa012b4ece02a: AViC has a predecessor established in 2013, and in 2018 Sōgo Ichihara became Representative Director and President and launched the digital marketing business. The group consists of five companies in total, comprising the company and four consolidated subsidiaries; consolidated employees as of September 30, 2025 numbered 91.
entries.a6c245b5dba43599: Consulting fees when only consulting is provided
entries.b0e5bd68776ebea0: Customers are companies that conduct sales promotion and marketing using the internet. There are two channels: direct provision to clients and provision through advertising agencies. Its major customer is ADK Digital Communications Inc.
entries.cde8b897b7588f30: It sets as its mission: “Team AViC will become the business driver and create new vistas for the world.” As its management strategy, it cites expanding transactions with direct clients through the provision of high-quality services, expanding collaboration with major general advertising agencies, and particularly raising its share with enterprise clients. In May 2024 it established a joint venture with ADK Marketing Solutions Inc., giving it a sales function, and states that this will strengthen support for enterprise clients. It also deploys “Cre Tech Force,” a solution that performs everything from analysis to production of advertising creatives using AI technology, and states that it aims to improve the effectiveness of performance-based advertising and differentiate itself. The other pillar is the recruitment and development of personnel; it states that it will strengthen its supply system through the enablement project, a training mechanism, and the development of in-house tools. It also states a policy of combining organic growth with inorganic growth such as M&A and expansion into China.
entries.cf1e66423283189c: A digital marketing company that provides internet advertising operation and SEO consulting.
entries.d917e32b6686c995: Planning and production of article content
entries.e11935f9636a0c9f: Net sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥2,680 million, up 38.6% from the previous consolidated fiscal year. By service, internet advertising accounted for ¥1,849 million and SEO consulting for ¥831 million. The company earns media fees and consulting fees from the sale of ad space, and only consulting fees when only consulting is provided.
entries.ee8023dbf150d0ce: This is based on the trends and breakdown of revenue printed in Trends in Management Indicators and Related Information (Information by Product and Service), and on the positioning of the business printed in the management policy, business environment and issues to be addressed, etc.
